Hi Olivia / Priyom,

Thanks — I reviewed the PDF and drafted an initial redline. Attaching our mark-up (Strobe_MSA_v1_redline.pdf) and a redlined Order Form doc. Topline summary so you can triage quickly:

Top 3 items (priority):
1) Liability cap and consequential damages carve-out: were proposing a clarified limitation of liability tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months and a mutual carve-out for gross negligence/intentional breach.
2) Data residency & Exhibit X: the MSA references "customer may request region" but we need Exhibit X that defines the selected region, data retention, and log export requirements for the pilot. Please advise which region Strobe requires (us-west/us-east/eu).
3) Indemnity and third-party claims: default mutual indemnity is OK but weve flagged a few vendor-specific clauses in Section 7 that reference third-party model providers — wed like to make the language mutual and capped.

Other asks:
- Please provide the full legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the signature page, plus the name/title/email of the authorized signatory.
- Confirm whether procurement requires a PO number and whether we should route invoices to contracts@strobesys.com or a different billing contact.
- If Strobe wants Dedicated capacity during pilot, pricing/lead times differ; Jonas will follow up separately on capacity options.

Attachments: Strobe_MSA_v1_redline.pdf (redline, summary comments), Strobe_OrderForm_Draft_redlines.docx (tracked changes)

Ive prioritized the redline to highlight items likely to affect legal approval and procurement. If you want, we can run an A/B: push for mutual indemnity + cap now and leave lower-priority compliance exhibits to post-signature addendum.

Would you be available for a 30-min call Thu 9/25 at 10:00am PT to walk the redlines? If not, suggest alternatives.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
